annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on EU concepts for transition management in a digitalised world of work — key input for an EU White Paper on the future of work
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on EU concepts for transition management in a digitalised world of work — key input for an EU White Paper on the future of work
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 367/15
annotation.summary_en: EESC exploratory opinion for the Austrian Presidency on managing the digital transition in work, as input to an EU White Paper. It stresses upskilling, social dialogue, social protection and a human-in-command approach to AI, and briefly welcomes collaborative robots as partners for workers.
key_provisions_or_claims: Supports a fair digital transition with no losers, backed by social policy investment and upskilling.
Advocates a human-in-command approach to AI as a guiding principle for future regulation.
Sees collaborative robots as beneficial partners for workers and people with disabilities.
Calls for informing and consulting workers' representatives and collective bargaining when robots are introduced.
Suggests an AI code of conduct and ethics training for engineers.
